edges.label: Sixteen years of silence is the stigma the assessment describes
edges.note: Dietrich gave her first public account in May 2021, weeks before ODNI conceded that aviators face 'disparagement associated with observing UAP, reporting it, or attempting to discuss it with colleagues.'

edges.label: Flew wing on the 14 Nov 2004 intercept; observed the object for about five minutes
edges.note: Dietrich and her WSO observed the object from roughly 8,000 feet above for about five minutes. She is named in the Navy range fouler report released 12 January 2023.

edges.label: Section lead and wingman on the same intercept
edges.note: Both are named as aircrew in the same Navy range fouler report and both gave first-person accounts on 60 Minutes in 2021.
